newsitem.title: USA: Sun Hydraulics says demand boosts backlog.
newsitem.headline: Sun Hydraulics says demand boosts backlog.

text.p: Sun Hydraulics Corp said Monday strong demand for its products has boosted its backlog, but has hurt its service.
The company said shipments are not increasing fast enough to offer the level of service it has historically provided its customers.
The company said, however, it expects second quarter shipments to be strong.
Sun Hydraulics designs and makes screw-in hydraulic cartridge valves and manifolds for global mobile and industrial markets.
